metadata.title: On the Geometry of Low Rank Correlation Matrices
metadata.abstract: Correlation matrices of bounded rank form a stratified space whose factor representations lie in a product of spheres. Using the orbit-type description of the rank stratification, we prove that padding factors preserves the Riemannian geometry of each fixed-rank stratum and the intrinsic length metric of every rank-bounded subset. In the reduced model, a Sylvester equation describes the mechanical connection and its horizontal lifts. We derive sectional-curvature formulas and bounds, characterize zero-curvature directions, and determine the connection's holonomy groups. In particular, a flat rank-two connection can have nontrivial dihedral holonomy. For geodesics subject to a rank bound, rank cannot decrease in the interior of a minimizing segment with maximal-rank endpoints; the local excess over the unconstrained quotient distance is controlled by a dimension-independent cubic estimate. Finally, we compute the exact change of measure between quotient Riemannian volume and Euclidean surface volume in the off-diagonal entries. Coarea yields explicit factor densities for both normalized uniform laws.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 低秩相关矩阵的分层几何
analysis.workSummary: 以球面乘积因子表示研究秩受限相关矩阵，证明补零保持各固定秩层和秩受限子集的长度几何，并计算机械连接、曲率、holonomy 和两种自然体积的变换。
analysis.breakthrough: 把低秩矩阵的局部黎曼量与全局秩约束测地行为统一起来。
analysis.limitations: 秩二平坦连接仍可能有非平凡二面体 holonomy；局部平坦不等于全局平凡，立方误差界也非全局相等。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 协助稿件组织、语言、数学推导起草和检查，未说明核心几何框架由模型提出。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 协助稿件组织、语言、数学推导起草和检查，未说明核心几何框架由模型提出。

analysis.priorityReason: 矩阵几何和统计形状空间计算的系统工具。
